item.title: Microsoft's October Security Update Fixes 1,400+ Vulnerabilities, One Exploited in the Wild
item.description: Microsoft's latest monthly security update addresses 1415 vulnerabilities across multiple products. One vulnerability affecting Windows Shell has been exploited in the wild, while 85 are classified as critical. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: The next circle of security hell
